description: Latvian company insolvency record from the official Uzņēmumu reģistrs open data (CC0, daily national photo since 2008): insolvency and legal-protection proceedings with dates, resolution, court and case number; a null end date means ongoing. A registered company with no proceeding returns an explicit positive answer (aucune_procedure: true): the register is authoritative, except for a company struck off before 2008, which the history does not cover (absence not conclusive, said in provenance). The answer carries the company's statut and statut_detail. Legal persons only: an individual merchant (IK), a sole trader or a form not recognised as a legal person returns 404, not billed. Paid via x402 ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.
